AbilityDef.description: Tear the caster in two in a short, bloody rite. Alone, a pawn struggles to rip its own flesh apart; two other colonists pulling at the halves make success far more likely, while a failed rite births a loyal fingerspike instead of a second body. Whatever the outcome, only half of the age and skill experience remains, worn apparel falls away and the flesh stays unstable for a while.
AbilityDef.label: flesh division
AbilityDef.confirmationDialogText: Start flesh division? {PAWN_nameDef} will be torn into two unstable bodies, each keeping half the age and skill experience, and worn apparel will fall to the ground.
